guides.title: 底部填膠流動控制：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Underfill flow control: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 毛細填膠的流動前緣可能包住空氣。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: An underfill flow front can trap air. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：毛細填膠的流動前緣可能包住空氣。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：比較流前緣時間序列、空洞圖及固化翹曲。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.
Mark this question on your own diagram: An underfill flow front can trap air. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Compare flow-front time series, void maps and cure warpage. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「比較流前緣時間序列、空洞圖及固化翹曲」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Compare flow-front time series, void maps and cure warpage, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

sources.title: AIM Photonics: Test, Assembly and Packaging

guides.scope: 原創觀察與驗證工作單，可離線閱讀。照片為代表性情境；未附本題專屬實測資料或生產配方。
guides.scopeEn: Original observation and verification worksheet readable offline. Photos provide representative context; no dedicated measured dataset or production recipe is bundled.

guides.title: 底部填膠流動控制：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Underfill flow control: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「間隙幾何」建立判讀邊界。局部間隙和凸塊障礙控制流動阻力。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Gap geometry to define the interpretation boundary. Local gaps and bump obstacles control flow resistance. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜間隙幾何：畫最窄通道及流動分岔。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 2｜焊點與通道：比較沿列與斜向流動示意。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 3｜返修與驗收：按產品邊界列雙重驗收條件。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Gap geometry: Map narrowest channels and flow splits. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 2 | Joints and channels: Compare row-aligned and diagonal flow. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 3 | Rework and acceptance: Define paired acceptance criteria for product boundaries. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「焊點與通道」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「返修與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Joints and channels: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Rework and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：平均間隙足以預測所有填充時間。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：看到遠端出膠即可證明中間已填滿。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Using mean gap to predict every fill time. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
Avoid: Using far-edge arrival as proof of complete internal fill. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

courses.overview: 依接口學習相近工法：毛細流動、填料與固化應力。每個比較保留共同機制及不可直接轉移的邊界。
courses.overviewEn: Learn related methods through interfaces: Capillary flow, fillers and cure stress. Each comparison retains both shared mechanisms and nontransferable boundaries.

related.title: 模封材料與翹曲控制
related.why: 聚合物 CTE、固化和水分影響應力
related.whyEn: Polymer CTE, cure and moisture affect stress
related.transfer: 聚合物 CTE、固化和水分影響應力
related.transferEn: Polymer CTE, cure and moisture affect stress
related.difference: 底膠受微間隙毛細作用，模封有不同流動與壓力边界
related.differenceEn: Underfill flows in narrow capillary gaps; molding has different pressure/flow boundaries
practice: 以「間隙幾何」畫出兩課的材料或資料交接，標明共同基準。
比較「局部間隙和凸塊障礙控制流動阻力。」在另一工法下還缺少哪項邊界條件。
用本課的「畫最窄通道及流動分岔。」設計一項可轉移和一項不可直接轉移的驗收證據。
practiceEn: Use gap geometry to draw material/data handoffs and shared datums.
Identify missing boundary conditions when applying this mechanism to the other process: Local gaps and bump obstacles control flow resistance.
Using "Map narrowest channels and flow splits.", define one transferable and one nontransferable acceptance item.
